name: Accelerate
description: Increases attack speed for each consecutive shot. Resets one second after the attack.

name: Acrobat
description: Reduces the cooldown time between rolls.

name: Ambush
description: Attacks on mobs that are not actively targeting you deal more damage.

name: Anima Conduit
description: Each soul absorbed grants a small amount of health.

name: Artifact Charge
description: When using an artifact, the player's next few attacks become charged.

name: Artifact Synergy
description: Using an artifact causes the next attack to deal bonus damage.

name: Bag of Souls
description: Increases the maximum number of souls that can be carried.

name: Beast Boss
description: Increases the amount of damage dealt by pets.

name: Beast Burst
description: Using a healing potion causes an explosion at pets' locations, dealing damage to mobs around them.

name: Beast Surge
description: Using health potion boosts pets' attack and movement speed for 10 seconds.

name: Bonus Shot
description: Firing a shot also fires a second shot at a nearby enemy. The second shot has reduced damage.

name: Burning
description: Every 0.5 seconds damages all nearby enemies.

name: Burst Bowstring
description: Shoots nearby mobs when the player rolls, costing one arrow per roll. Projectiles deal 40% of a charged shot's damage.

name: Busy Bee
description: Grants a chance for a bee to spawn after defeating a mob, with up to 3 bees joining the hero's side.

name: Chain Reaction
description: Has a chance to fire five arrows in all directions on impact.

name: Chains
description: Has a 30% chance to chain a cluster of mobs together and keep them bound for a short time.

name: Chilling
description: Emits a blast every two seconds that reduces the movement and attack speed of nearby enemies for one second.

name: Committed
description: Deal increased damage against already wounded mobs.

name: Cool Down
description: Reduces the cool-down time between uses of artifacts.

name: Cooldown Shot
description: Artifact cooldowns are decreased when attacking with a charged shot.

name: Cowardice
description: Deal increased ranged and melee damage while at full health.

name: Critical Hit
description: Gives a chance to inflict critical hits dealing triple damage.

name: Death Barter
description: The first set of Emeralds collected are stored and then spent to save the player from death.
gildedDescription: Can spend emeralds to cheat death

name: Deflect
description: Grants a small chance to deflect incoming projectiles.

name: Dipping Poison
description: When you use a health potion, you are given a quiver of Poison Arrows.

name: Dynamo
description: Adds damage to the next attack after rolling.

name: Echo
description: Some attacks can be followed up by another attack in quick succession.

name: Electrified
description: Rolling zaps two nearby enemies with lightning bolts, dealing damage.

name: Emerald Shield
description: Invulnerability on emerald collection

name: Enigma Resonator
description: Chance to deal triple damage based on the number of souls the hero has.

name: Environmental Protection
description: Environmental damage resistance

name: Exploding
description: Mobs explode after they are defeated.

levels.text: 20% Deals X% of enemy health as damage
40% Deals X% of enemy health as damage
60% Deals X% of enemy health as damage

name: Explorer
description: Regain a small amount of health for every 100 blocks explored on the map.

name: Final Shout
description: When the player's health drops below 25%, all artifacts are used (ignoring cool-down periods).

name: Fire Aspect
description: Sets mobs on fire for three seconds, dealing damage over time.

name: Fire Focus
description: Increase fire damage dealt by the player.

name: Fire Trail
description: Rolling creates a trail of fire that deals damage to mobs for four seconds.

name: Food Reserves
description: Using a healing potion also creates a random food item.

name: Freezing
description: Slows mobs after hit for three seconds.

name: Frenzied
description: Player's attack speed is increased while at less than half health.
gildedDescription: Attack speed boost at low HP

name: Fuse Shot
description: Every few shots has a timed charge that explodes one second after impact, dealing 100% damage to nearby mobs.

name: Gravity
description: This effect pulls mobs in range toward the weapon's impact point.

name: Gravity Pulse
description: A blast occurs every three seconds that pulls nearby enemies nearer.

name: Growing
description: The fired shot grows in the air, dealing extra damage to distant targets.

name: Guarding Strike
description: After defeating a mob, gain a temporary shield that reduces damage by 50%.

name: Health Synergy
description: Regain a small amount of health when activating any artifact.

name: Illager's Bane
description: Attacks deal extra damage to Illagers.

name: Infinity
description: Chance to immediately replenish an arrow after shooting.

levels.text: 16% chance of arrow not being used
32% chance of arrow not being used
48% chance of arrow not being used

name: Jungle Poison
description: Inflicts poison

name: Leeching
description: Defeating a mob heals the hero by a small portion of the mob's max health.

name: Levitation Shot
description: After rolling, the next attack will cause the target to levitate briefly.

name: Life Boost
description: Maximum health increases each time the player loses a life.

name: Lightning Focus
description: Increases lightning damage dealt by the player.

name: Looting
description: Increases the chance for mobs to drop consumables.

name: Luck of the Sea
description: Increases luck, boosting the chance of unique rare drops.

name: Lucky Explorer
description: Chance to spawn emeralds with every block explored.
gildedDescription: Chance to spawn emeralds when exploring

name: Multi-Roll
description: Grants extra rolls.

name: Multishot
description: Grants the chance to fire five arrows at once.

name: Overcharge
description: Continue to hold the ranged attack button to double, triple, or quadruple charge a bow, increasing its damage each time.

name: Pain Cycle
description: Attacking drains player's life to grant one stack of Pain Cycle. At 5 stacks, pain is channeled into the next attack.

levels.text: Triple (3x) Max stacks does X damage
Quadruple (4x) Max stacks does X damage
Quintuple (5x) Max stacks does X damage

name: Piercing
description: Fired arrows sometimes gain the piercing effect, which allows them to fly through multiple mobs.

name: Poison Cloud
description: Has a 30% chance to summon a poison cloud that deals damage to enemies in an area for three seconds.

name: Poison Focus
description: Increased poison damage dealt by the player.

name: Potion Barrier
description: Take -90% damage for a short duration when using a healing potion.

name: Power
description: Power boosts arrow damage.

name: Prospector
description: Find more emeralds on fallen enemies.

name: Protection
description: Reduces damage taken.

name: Punch
description: Boosts arrow pushback.

name: Radiance
description: Has a 20% chance to spawn a circular area that heals all allies within it.

name: Radiance Shot
description: Has a 50% chance to spawn a circular area that heals all allies within it.

name: Rampaging
description: After defeating a mob, there is a 10% chance to increase attack speed by +50% for a short time.

name: Rapid Fire
description: Increases attack speed.

name: Reckless
description: Decreases player health by 40% while increasing melee damage.

name: Recycler
description: Being hit by damage-inflicting projectiles occasionally crafts a small quiver of arrows.

name: Refreshment
description: Defeating a mob reduces health potion's cooldown time, allowing player to heal more quickly.

name: Reliable Ricochet
description: Charged arrows ricochet off of mobs up to three times.

name: Ricochet
description: Small chance for arrows to ricochet off mobs.

name: Roll Charge
description: After rolling the next shot is charged.

name: Rush
description: Increases movement speed for one second after taking damage.

name: Rushdown
description: 100% increased speed temporarily after defeating a mob. Speed burst after mob defeated.

name: Shadow Barb
description: First shot does not break Shadow Form

name: Shadow Blast
description: Leaving Shadow Form triggers a powerful blast that damages nearby mobs.
gildedDescription: You make a blast around you when leaving Shadow Form

levels.text: 2 blocks radius Triggers a blast around you.
3 block radius Triggers a blast around you.
4 block radius Triggers a blast around you.

name: Shadow Shot
description: Chance of Shadow Form on kills

name: Shadow Surge
description: Mobs defeated while in Shadow Form grant extra souls.

name: Shared Pain
description: Excess damage hits nearby mobs

name: Sharpness
description: Sharpens the player's weapon, causing it to deal more damage.

name: Shock Web
description: Beams of lightning connect the last few charged arrows fired, which deal lightning damage to enemies who touch a beam.

name: Shockwave
description: The last attack in a combo launches a shockwave, damaging enemies.

name: Smiting
description: Increases damage against the Undead.

name: Snowball
description: Fires a snowball at a nearby enemy every few seconds, briefly stunning it.

levels.text: Every second Triggers every X seconds

name: Soul Focus
description: Increases soul damage dealt by the player.

name: Soul Siphon
description: When hitting an enemy, gain a 20% chance to grant extra souls.

name: Soul Speed
description: Gathering a soul causes a gain of 5% stacking movement speed boost for a short time.

name: Speed Synergy
description: When activating any artifact, gain +20% movement speed for a short time.

name: Stunning
description: Chance to temporarily stun enemies.

name: Supercharge
description: Charged shots deal more damage and have more pushback.

name: Surprise Gift
description: Using a healing potion sometimes also creates a random consumable.
gildedDescription: Can get consumable on potion use

name: Swiftfooted
description: Rolling increases movement speed for three seconds.

name: Swirling
description: The last attack in a combo performs a swirling attack, damaging nearby enemies.

name: Tempo Theft
description: Steals a small amount of a mob's movement speed and gives it to the player for four seconds.

name: Thorns
description: Taking damage deals damage back to the attacker.

name: Thrive Under Pressure
description: Takes less damage when swarmed

name: Thundering
description: Has a 30% chance to summon a lightning strike that damages nearby enemies.

name: Tumblebee
description: Chance to summon a bee when rolling, with up to 3 bees joining the player's side.

name: Unchanting
description: Deals more damage to enchanted enemies.

name: Void Strike
description: Attacking a target applies a damage multiplier that rises steadily to a max level, then is removed.

name: Weakening
description: The player's attacks decrease the attack damage of all nearby enemies for five seconds.

name: Wild Rage
description: Hitting an enemy has a chance to send it into a rage, making it hostile toward everyone.
